platform: WIDR 89.1 FM Music Airtime Email and External Form Route
manual_review_reason: WIDR explicitly invites music-airtime requests through widr-music@wmich.edu, two external independent-artist/promoter submission links and a postal route. A human must choose the appropriate route, use the requested subject-line category, inspect the external form destination for session or CAPTCHA controls, prepare metadata and rights-cleared assets, and avoid submitting through more than one route without authorization.

platform: WSUM 91.7 FM Music Director Submission Route
manual_review_reason: WSUM explicitly tells artists to send music to its Music Director, but the public email is rendered as a protected/non-plaintext link and the page does not publish file-format, attachment, download-link, metadata or clean-edit requirements. A human must use the official contact link without decoding or guessing it, confirm the preferred package and complete the editorial pitch manually.

platform: KGLT Alternative Public Radio Music Director Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: KGLT publishes a current Music Director contact link and station mailing address but does not explicitly state accepted music-delivery formats, attachment or download-link rules, release windows or whether unsolicited physical media are accepted. A human must send a limited pre-submission inquiry through the official protected contact without attachments or track links and wait for authorization.

platform: WMUC 90.5 FM General Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: WMUC publishes wmuc@umd.edu and a station address but does not publish an explicit music-submission recipient, accepted formats, file or link rules, metadata requirements or unsolicited-media policy on the current site. A human must send only a concise pre-submission inquiry without audio attachments or track links and wait for routing instructions.

platform: Impact 89FM WDBM General Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
manual_review_reason: Impact 89FM publishes an official general contact email link and office details but no explicit current music-submission workflow, recipient, attachment policy, download-link rules or release metadata requirements. A human must use the official protected contact only for a limited routing inquiry, without files or music links, and wait for authorization before delivery.
